verdict.rationale: Jeeves supports exporting filtered transactions to CSV and every transaction export includes reference ID, timestamp, and on-chain hash, plus one-click sync with accounting tools — these are open, portable formats. However, there is no evidence of a full account/data export (e.g., all cards, expenses, receipts, team data) or an explicit data-portability/account-closure workflow to 'leave' with all data. missing for 10: comprehensive full-account data export beyond transactions, documented data portability/deletion process, independent verification of export completeness.
